description_en: Retrieves the list of commands that require approval
description_zh: 获取需要审批的命令列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-approve-commands --instance-id bastionhost-cn-zvp2xvysf08 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListApproveCommands

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the Bastionhost.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain the parameter value
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.
For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page for a paged query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page for a paged query.  
The maximum value of the PageSize parameter is 1000. The default number of entries per page is 20. If the PageSize parameter is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
Specify a value for the PageSize parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为1000。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
